controls.title: Isolation locked, tagged and tried before work starts

Fan brake on and the fan locked against turning in the wind
Line drained and vented: its gauge reads zero before opening
Actuator's stored energy released before taking it apart
Valve moved only by agreement, from the local station, hands clear
Left to cool; temperature checked before touching
Harness on and clipped to an anchor point at height
Platform or scaffold inspected and tagged safe before use
Area below barriered off; tools tethered
Lifting plan: certified slings and hoist within rating, nobody under the load
Heavy parts moved by two people or with a lifting aid
Work gloves for the job
Safety glasses
Hearing protection in the noisy areas
Chemical goggles, gloves and apron; safety data sheet read; eyewash checked
Gas tested before entry, a standby person at the entry
Dust mask or respirator; the space ventilated
No hot work or other ignition near; tins kept closed
Spills cleaned up at once; walkways kept clear
Control room told before and after; the instrument's trips and alarms checked with them
Cab and counterweight secured; brake held before work in the shaft
